title: Jejune
summary: JEJU'NE, adjective [Latin jejunus, empty, dry.] 1. Wanting; empty; vacant. 2. Hungry; not saturated. 3. Dry; barren; wanting interesting matter; as a jejune narrative.

inlines.v: JEJU'NE, adjective [Latin jejunus, empty, dry.] 1. Wanting; empty; vacant. 2. Hungry; not saturated. 3. Dry; barren; wanting interesting matter; as a jejune narrative.
